changes.summary: New Playoff Odds page: every team's chance to make the playoffs (and earn a bye), plus the games this week that move it most.
The Saturday Matchup Preview is now chart-led: a playoff race board up top, then a card per game with the rivalry, last five weeks, what's at stake and the schedule left.
The standings Playoffs tab now shows each team's playoff odds on its seed tile, with Odds and Bye columns in the table.
Saturday's group chat lineup check now names every team with no lineup, an empty slot or an OUT/IR/bye starter. Sunday reminders are push only.

The Saturday Matchup Preview is now chart-led: a playoff race board up top, then a card per game with the rivalry, last five weeks, what's at stake and the schedule left.

Ask the History can now count across the whole record: most trades in a single day, most waiver pickups in a week, who has traded the most.
The trade deadline now follows the Constitution, the Friday before Week 11 at 8:45pm PT, everywhere on the site instead of a fixed Nov 13.
Sorting a roster by a future salary year now switches the cap totals, Cap Subtotals card and cap space (header and phone card) to that year, labeled with it.
